# fakenvapi reference snapshot

- Upstream: https://github.com/optiscaler/fakenvapi

The snapshot in this directory is retained for architectural/reference purposes and is not compiled by ISB. The upstream file depends on Windows, D3D, NVAPI, and other fakenvapi support components.

The SPDX/provenance header is the only ISB-added modification to the snapshot.
